_doc: Loop registry: every recurring loop Ultrastable runs on itself, where it runs, how often, its evidence path and closing probe. `python3 -m foundation launch` runs all of them once; every host only schedules that command. Server-side only (owner, 2026-11-12): every host names the platform it runs on in `runs_on`, one of the platforms in doctrine/server-side.json; a host on a person's computer fails `python3 -m foundation serverside --check`. Changed by reviewed PR.

loops.what: manager heartbeat: reconcile, claims, gates, predictions, trust, dispatch, plus share
plus share of finished and queued work against the protected budget
selfhost verifier and gap-register closing probes
funding and outreach engine run; all contact dry-run until outreach/gate.json is live
evidence and four-line report committed to the repository on branch loop-evidence
public read-only snapshot of managers, loops, claim checks and the change feed, published to ultrastable.io/live
closing-probe contracts, meta-ticket fold, family throughput, metric loop, ignition gaps and the criticality tick (foundation/sauce.py)

hosts.cadence: every 10 minutes (existing worker ultrastable-tick, D1 ultrastable-org)
hourly cloud-hosted routine (runs in Anthropic's cloud; no desktop app or person's computer is involved)
daily failover gate + dispatch (free-minutes rule: about one minute a day while another host is alive)

failover.rule: a fallback host runs the loop only when no host has written evidence for its takeover_after_hours; the evidence record names the host that took over. The credential-free fallback is github-actions: its built-in token is minted by GitHub per run, so no person mints, stores or renews anything for it
